R3   6
R4   7 Kvit Notes is a native markdown block editor and notes app: your notes are
R5   8 plain `.md` files on disk, shown fully rendered, with the raw syntax of a
R6   9 span revealed only while your cursor is inside it.
R7  10
R8  11 ![The three-pane shell: live-preview editing with inline math, a callout, a>
R9  12
R10  13 **[See it working](gallery.md)**: fourteen short clips of the real
R11  14 application, one per feature, with a paragraph on each.
R12  15

R16  19 |---|---|
